interpretation: Three independent real-client screenshots establish that binding the already loaded AK-47 XModel to the active weapon definition is sufficient to show the body in the current setup. This is a reversible client-memory diagnostic, not a server-controlled or durable implementation. The earlier §1272 inference that model loading ruled out a binding defect was too broad: the asset was loaded, but the active weapon definition still selected tag_origin. No shooting or movement success is claimed.
